decisions.reason: Using the provided logo and branding does not change the master site's role, booking model, national scope, or positioning.
The logo decision is compatible with the existing competitor-referenced layout and visual-style requirements and does not replace any of their current attributes.
Logo and branding usage does not alter the mobile-friendly behavior of the site.
The provided branding can be applied within the reusable template without changing its reuse strategy, Seattle basis, or no-redesign requirement.
The branding instruction does not change the available locations, selector behavior, or routing destinations.
The dedicated-page model and cross-location consistency remain valid; the specific logo belongs to the separate brand-identity Requirement.
Selecting the logo does not change the existing requirement to minimize SEO damage during the branding and website transition.
The branding instruction does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, page sections, button label, or opening transition.
Logo and branding usage has no necessary effect on the booking platform, hosting model, or Seattle booking activation rules.
Shared customer-facing branding does not alter the required isolation of location accounts, data, reporting, or access.
The branding instruction does not change the VIP signup type or its Join VIP List button label.
Applying the provided logo and branding does not add, remove, or otherwise change the required homepage sections or offerings visibility.
